verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a sandbox mode for code/tool/network execution in Gemini CLI (only vague 'Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance' with no detail), and community reports (gemini-cli-comm-17) explicitly note Gemini CLI lacks directory-trust prompts and opens freely in root directories, unlike competitors with stronger isolation. No first-party sandbox feature, flag, or config is evidenced.
